# Smoke Test Failure Analysis — Nightly Run Report

---

## 1. Categorized Failures

### Category A: Model Deprecated (HTTP 404 Not Found)

| # | Model | Provider |
|---|-------|----------|
| 10 | gemini-1.5-pro | Google |
| 11 | gemini-1.5-flash | Google |
| 12 | gpt-3.5-turbo | OpenAI |
| 13 | claude-2.1 | Anthropic |

**Explanation:** The provider has permanently retired these model endpoints. The API returns `404 Not Found` because the model identifier no longer resolves to a servable resource. These models have reached end-of-life in the provider's model lifecycle and will never come back online.

---

### Category B: Authentication / Authorization Failure (HTTP 401 Unauthorized)

| # | Model | Provider |
|---|-------|----------|
| 15 | mistral-medium | Mistral |
| 16 | codestral | Mistral |

**Explanation:** The API key used for the Mistral provider is either expired, revoked, or was rotated without updating our configuration. Both Mistral failures share the same root cause — a single invalid credential — since `mistral-large` (also Mistral) would likely also fail if it used the same key. The fact that `mistral-large` passes suggests either (a) it uses a different API key or (b) these two models require a different tier/plan key (e.g., a separate "codestral" entitlement).

---

### Category C: Upstream Provider Outage (HTTP 503 Service Unavailable)

| # | Model | Provider |
|---|-------|----------|
| 19 | deepseek-chat | DeepSeek |
| 20 | deepseek-reasoner | DeepSeek |

**Explanation:** DeepSeek's servers are temporarily down or overloaded. The `503` indicates the provider acknowledges the request but cannot serve it. This is typically a transient issue on the provider side and outside our control.

---

### Category D: Network / Connectivity Failure (Connection Timeout)

| # | Model | Provider |
|---|-------|----------|
| 21 | qwen-turbo | Alibaba |
| 22 | qwen-plus | Alibaba |

**Explanation:** Our infrastructure could not establish a TCP connection to the Alibaba endpoint within the 30-second timeout. Possible causes include: DNS resolution failure, firewall/egress rules blocking the Alibaba Cloud domain, regional network issues, or the Alibaba endpoint being down. Both models share the same provider, pointing to a single connectivity issue.

---

### Category E: Configuration / Request Error (HTTP 400 Bad Request)

| # | Model | Provider |
|---|-------|----------|
| 23 | phi-3-mini | Azure |

**Explanation:** The model identifier `phi-3-mini` is not recognized by the Azure endpoint we're targeting. This is likely a misconfiguration: either the model name doesn't match Azure's expected deployment name (Azure OpenAI requires you to use *your deployment name*, not the base model name), or the model was never deployed on this Azure resource.

---

## 2. Prioritized Fix Plan

### Priority 1 — Category B: Authentication Failure (Mistral)

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Immediate action** | Verify the API key stored for Mistral in the secrets vault. Check whether `mistral-large` uses a different key. Regenerate or rotate the Mistral API key in the Mistral console, then update the configuration. Confirm whether `mistral-medium` and `codestral` require a separate subscription tier or key. |
| **Time estimate** | 15–30 minutes |
| **Owner** | **API / Platform team** (manages secrets and provider credentials) |

> **Rationale for P1:** This is entirely within our control and blocks two models that are likely still valid. Fastest win.

---

### Priority 2 — Category E: Configuration Error (Azure / phi-3-mini)

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Immediate action** | Log into the Azure portal, verify the actual deployment name for Phi-3 on our Azure OpenAI resource. Update the model config to use the correct deployment name (e.g., `phi-3-mini-128k-instruct` or whatever the deployment was named). Re-run the smoke test for this model only. |
| **Time estimate** | 15–30 minutes |
| **Owner** | **Infra team** (manages Azure resource deployments and model config) |

> **Rationale for P2:** Also entirely within our control; likely a one-line config fix.

---

### Priority 3 — Category D: Connection Timeout (Alibaba / Qwen)

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Immediate action** | 1) Test connectivity manually: `curl -v https://<alibaba-endpoint>`. 2) Check firewall/egress rules and DNS resolution for Alibaba Cloud domains. 3) Check Alibaba Cloud status page for outages. 4) If networking is fine on our side, open a support ticket with Alibaba. |
| **Time estimate** | 30 minutes – 2 hours (depending on whether it's our network or theirs) |
| **Owner** | **Infra / Network team** (if egress/firewall issue); **API team** (if endpoint URL misconfiguration) |

> **Rationale for P3:** Could be our infra or theirs — requires diagnosis before action.

---

### Priority 4 — Category C: Upstream Outage (DeepSeek)

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Immediate action** | Check DeepSeek's status page or community channels for known outages. Set up an automated retry/monitor to re-test every hour. No config changes needed on our side. |
| **Time estimate** | 5 minutes (to verify); then **wait** for provider recovery |
| **Owner** | **API / Platform team** (monitoring); **DeepSeek** (resolution) |

> **Rationale for P4:** Nothing we can fix; we just need to confirm it's transient and monitor for recovery.

---

### Priority 5 — Category A: Deprecated Models

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Immediate action** | Remove all four deprecated models from the configuration file. Identify any downstream consumers (apps, agents, pipelines) still referencing these models and migrate them to successors (see table below). Update documentation. |
| **Time estimate** | 30 minutes – 1 hour (config change is fast; consumer audit may take longer) |
| **Owner** | **API / Platform team** (config removal); **Product / Application teams** (consumer migration) |

**Suggested migration paths:**

| Deprecated Model | Recommended Successor |
|---|---|
| gemini-1.5-pro | gemini-2.0-flash (or gemini-2.5-pro when available) |
| gemini-1.5-flash | gemini-2.0-flash |
| gpt-3.5-turbo | gpt-4o-mini |
| claude-2.1 | claude-haiku-3-5 (cost-sensitive) or claude-sonnet-4 |

> **Rationale for P5:** These will never recover, but they're also not urgent since they're already broken. The cleanup is important for hygiene but not time-sensitive.

---

## 3. Removal Recommendations

| Model | Action | Reason |
|-------|--------|--------|
| gemini-1.5-pro | **🗑️ Remove** | Permanently deprecated by Google; 404 will never resolve. Migrate consumers to `gemini-2.0-flash`. |
| gemini-1.5-flash | **🗑️ Remove** | Permanently deprecated by Google; 404 will never resolve. `gemini-2.0-flash` is the direct successor. |
| gpt-3.5-turbo | **🗑️ Remove** | Permanently deprecated by OpenAI. `gpt-4o-mini` is cheaper, faster, and more capable — already in our config. |
| claude-2.1 | **🗑️ Remove** | Permanently deprecated by Anthropic. Multiple superior Claude models already available in config. |
| mistral-medium | **🔧 Keep (fix)** | Likely a valid model behind an expired API key. Fix the credential and re-evaluate. If Mistral has also deprecated this model, then remove. |
| codestral | **🔧 Keep (fix)** | Specialized code model from Mistral; valuable for code-generation use cases. Fix the API key/entitlement. |
| deepseek-chat | **🔧 Keep (fix)** | Transient 503 outage on provider side. DeepSeek is a cost-effective model; monitor and keep. |
| deepseek-reasoner | **🔧 Keep (fix)** | Same transient outage. Valuable reasoning model; no action needed beyond monitoring. |
| qwen-turbo | **🔧 Keep (investigate)** | Timeout may be a network/firewall issue on our side. Investigate connectivity; if Alibaba is unreachable from our infra long-term, consider removal. |
| qwen-plus | **🔧 Keep (investigate)** | Same as qwen-turbo. Keep pending connectivity investigation. |
| phi-3-mini | **🔧 Keep (fix)** | The model likely exists but is misconfigured in our system. Fix the deployment name in Azure config. |

---

## 4. Passing Model Notes

### ⚠️ Performance Concern

| Model | ttft | Concern |
|-------|------|---------|
| **o1** | **8,341 ms** | Time-to-first-token is **~10–20x slower** than all other passing models. While this is expected for OpenAI's reasoning models (chain-of-thought happens before token output), this should be monitored. If this model is used in user-facing synchronous workflows, consider adding a loading indicator, increasing timeout thresholds, or routing only async/batch workloads to it. Confirm the 8.3s is consistent with prior runs and not a regression. |

### 🔁 Redundancy Review

| Provider | Models | Observation |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| **OpenAI** | gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo, o1, o3-mini | **5 models.** `gpt-4-turbo` (534ms) is the legacy predecessor to `gpt-4o` (412ms). Unless specific consumers depend on `gpt-4-turbo`'s behavior, consider sunsetting it to reduce surface area. `gpt-4o` and `gpt-4o-mini` serve the "fast/capable" and "fast/cheap" tiers well. `o1` and `o3-mini` serve the reasoning tier. |
| **Anthropic** | claude-opus-4, claude-sonnet-4, claude-haiku-3-5 | **3 models — well-structured.** These map to premium/mid/fast tiers cleanly. No redundancy concern. |
| **Groq** | llama-3.3-70b, llama-3.1-8b | **2 models — reasonable.** 70B for quality, 8B for speed/cost. However, `llama-3.1-8b` is a prior generation; consider upgrading to `llama-3.3-8b` if Groq offers it. |

### 📋 Summary of Passing Model Actions

| Model | Status | Recommended Action |
|-------|--------|--------------------|
| gpt-4o | ✅ Healthy | None |
| gpt-4o-mini | ✅ Healthy | None |
| gpt-4-turbo | ✅ Healthy | **Consider deprecating** in favor of gpt-4o (faster, newer) |
| o1 | ⚠️ Slow | **Monitor ttft trends**; ensure appropriate timeout settings; restrict to async use cases |
| o3-mini | ✅ Healthy | None |
| claude-opus-4 | ✅ Healthy | None |
| claude-sonnet-4 | ✅ Healthy | None |
| claude-haiku-3-5 | ✅ Healthy | None |
| gemini-2.0-flash | ✅ Healthy | None |
| mistral-large | ✅ Healthy | None |
| llama-3.3-70b | ✅ Healthy | None |
| llama-3.1-8b | ✅ Healthy | Consider upgrading to latest Llama 3.3 8B if available |

---

## 5. Executive Summary

Last night's smoke test showed **9 of 23 models passing** and **14 failing**, with failures falling into five root causes: 4 deprecated models (permanent), 2 auth failures (Mistral API key), 2 upstream outages (DeepSeek), 2 connection timeouts (Alibaba), and 1 misconfiguration (Azure). **We recommend immediately removing the 4 deprecated models** (gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash, gpt-3.5-turbo, claude-2.1) from the configuration and **prioritizing the Mistral API key fix and Azure deployment name correction**, as those are quick wins entirely within our control. The DeepSeek and Alibaba issues require monitoring and investigation respectively, and among passing models, `o1`'s 8.3-second ttft and `gpt-4-turbo`'s potential redundancy with `gpt-4o` warrant follow-up review.
